question_cn: 引离战术的核心逻辑是什么？
question_en: What is the core idea behind a deflection?

options.text_cn: 吃掉对方价值最低的棋子换取子力优势
options.text_en: Capture the opponent's least valuable piece to gain a material advantage

options.text_cn: 强迫对方"过载"的防守棋子离开岗位，使其无法同时完成两项防守任务
options.text_en: Force an overloaded defender away from its post so it can no longer protect two targets at once

options.text_cn: 将王驱赶到角落后再实施将杀
options.text_en: Drive the king to a corner before delivering checkmate

options.text_cn: 用兵链封锁对方所有出路
options.text_en: Use a pawn chain to block all of the opponent's escape squares

explanation_cn: 引离的核心是利用对方的"过载"（Overloading）弱点：某个棋子同时守护两个或多个关键点，我方献子或进攻迫使它二选一——无论它选哪个方向移动，另一个防守任务必然落空，己方随即利用这个漏洞得子或将杀。
explanation_en: Deflection exploits an overloaded defender: one piece is responsible for guarding two or more critical points. A sacrifice or direct attack forces it to choose between them. Whichever duty it abandons leaves the other target vulnerable to capture or checkmate.
